stem.text: The graph shows the oxygen dissociation curves of adult haemoglobin at two partial pressures of carbon dioxide W and X.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage saturation of haemoglobin with oxygen against partial pressure of oxygen in kPa, with two curves labelled curve X and curve W.

stem.text: Which pair of statements are correct?

items: Curve W shows the oxygen dissociation curve at a higher concentration of carbon dioxide than curve X.
Curve X shows the oxygen dissociation curve at a higher concentration of carbon dioxide than curve W.
At a partial pressure of oxygen of $7.0\,\text{kPa}$ the haemoglobin from curve W has a higher affinity for oxygen than haemoglobin from curve X.
At a partial pressure of oxygen of $7.0\,\text{kPa}$ the haemoglobin from curve X has a higher affinity for oxygen than haemoglobin from curve W.
